nodes.name: Calendar Check Webhook
nodes.notes: The dashboard's Team page (Check calendars). Header Auth: Elliot Internal Webhook Secret.

parameters.query:
-- 0042: the agency's agents' calendars and its own (not 'primary').
select calendars_to_check($1::uuid) as calendars;

nodes.name: Add To Elliot's Calendars
nodes.notes: Adds each shared calendar to Elliot's Google account (harmless if it's there already) and tells what it may do with it.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ timeMin: new Date().toISOString(), timeMax: new Date(Date.now() + 86400000).toISOString(), items: $('Split Calendars').all().map((i) => i.json.calendar_id).filter(Boolean).map((id) => ({ id })) }) }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: true, account_email: $('Read Results').first().json.account_email, results: $('Read Results').first().json.results }) }}

meta.description: 0042: can Elliot's Google account see and add viewings to each agent's calendar? Called from the Team page.
